elevenlabs.catalogNotes: Eleven v4 supports public HTTP speech and native dialogue. Retain v3 for existing voice characterization and cross-language accent behavior; keep v3 as the explicit bare-provider default pending audible migration assessment. Turbo realtime variants remain excluded.

eleven_v3.description: ElevenLabs v3 expressive speech and native dialogue
eleven_v3.pricingTier: Published v3 API character rate across Free/PAYG and listed subscription tiers
eleven_v3.pricingNotes: The API pricing page lists v3 at $0.08/1K characters across Free/PAYG, Starter, Creator, Pro, Scale, and Business. Synthesis uses this character rate for speech and native dialogue; any recorded voice-cloning or setup charge is accounted for separately. Subscription inclusions, account-specific discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are excluded from this usage estimate.

eleven_v4.description: ElevenLabs v4 expressive speech and native dialogue
eleven_v4.pricingNotes: Published $0.08 per 1,000 characters without recurring commitment. Voice setup, premium plan-gated formats, taxes and discounts are excluded. Single-voice TTS supports 10,000 characters; native dialogue uses the separate 2,000-total-character/10-voice endpoint limit. Timing estimates reuse the v3 heuristic and are not measured v4 latency.
